problem: On iPhone the pricing lifecycle/package/billing controls rendered but taps produced no visible state change, while the language selector could navigate to an English route that an offline production build had not emitted.
root_cause: Pricing interaction ownership had regressed to two competing runtimes after build restore: an inline bg-pricing-neno-v1-js owner plus pricing-interactions-rescue-v1.js. The build-integrity step reinstalled both owners on every Netlify build. On the 390px production proof the lifecycle control existed but had no actionable visible hitbox. The billing proof also checked aria-selected although the control contract is aria-pressed.
prevention: Exactly one canonical delegated pricing controller may exist after source build and build-integrity restore.
Build integrity must remove inline/rescue legacy owners before injecting assets/js/pricing-interactions-v4.js.
Lifecycle controls must retain explicit mobile hitboxes: visible, nonzero min-height, pointer-events enabled and horizontally scrollable.
Production proof scrolls the lifecycle control into view, proves visibility before click, verifies visible panel state, and checks billing with aria-pressed.
Public language switching must navigate to the static localized /en route and production proof must reject a visible runtime failure message.
Do not claim closure until exact provider SHA/deploy identity and production browser interaction proof succeed.
